Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. Why do angels use or need a golden card to leave and enter heaven
2. How is it  explained that the events of 66 through 70 AD are part of the 70-week prophecy
3. What is the uncovering of feet - Book of Ruth
.
